title: Describe a Course You Would Like to Take

source.rights: 项目原创虚构教学材料；AI 编写并对照教学规则、原文和题目证据复核。
source.reviewScope: Ordinary A2 practice. Exact source contexts and answers reviewed; synthetic en-US audio checked for file integrity, decoding, role/segment alignment and unprompted ASR content. Pronunciation and intonation are not independently certified.

instructions: Prepare briefly, then record your own answer. Speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
prompt: Describe a course you would like to take. Explain the subject, what you want to learn, why you want to study it, and how you will manage the work. Speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
reference: I would like to take an evening course at a local college. I want to learn about geography because I enjoy reading about places and people. I plan to visit the campus to ask about the curriculum and the time of each lesson. A short lecture could introduce a topic, and a seminar could give students time to discuss it. I would like to do research about my neighborhood and write a report. I work during the day, so I want to avoid studying too late. I will finish my homework in two short sessions each week. If I need help with an assignment, I will ask the teacher for a tutorial.
